title: AI Old Photo Animator
summary: Animate old photos with AI. Upload a family photo, describe a small movement, and Flick brings the people in it to life. See 8 examples with their prompts.
body_markdown:
### Can I animate old photos for free?


Yes, you can start free: you get 100 credits when you sign up, 200 more for joining the Flick Discord, and 100 credits every week. The clips on this page used MiniMax H3 Fast, which runs on the free plan, and downloads carry a Flick watermark until the Standard plan.


### Are these real old photos?


No. Every photo on this page was generated in Flick to show the method, so no real family's pictures are used. The same steps work on a scan of your own photo.


### Will the people still look like themselves?


Usually, when the movement is small and the prompt says every face keeps its features. Larger movements, turned heads and blurry or damaged faces are where a face is most likely to change, so check each take.


### Which old photos animate best?


Sharp, front-facing photos with faces that are not too small work best. A group photo works too, as long as you give each person a small action of their own.


### Can I animate a black and white photo?


Yes. Say in the prompt that the photo stays black and white, or sepia, so the model keeps the original tones instead of adding colour.


### Is it okay to animate photos of people who have died?


Many people animate family photos as a way to remember someone. Think about how relatives might feel, and ask permission before you share an animated photo of someone else's family.
